summary: A conditional shortlist choice for heritage architecture and a luxurious riverside meal. The opening date is supported: Langham's August 2026 announcement accepts stays from 20 December 2026, and its inaugural offer specifies that year. As of the planning date, this is an announced opening, not evidence of an operating attraction. The restored 1888 Custom House is intended to contain public dining and lifestyle spaces; accommodation occupies an adjacent contemporary building.
whyGo: See an important riverside trading landmark given a new use.
Combine architectural interest with a celebratory drink or meal if visitor access is confirmed.
The neo-Palladian façade, teak floors and grand staircase distinguish it from a generic hotel stop.
bestFor: Couples seeking a special riverside occasion
skipIf: You need a confirmed museum-style visit with published admission and hours
duration: Allow 1–2 hours for a future meal or drinks visit; planning estimate, not a published tour duration. The opening accommodation package is three nights.
cost: No verified standalone admission or restaurant prices. The advertised three-night Classic Room opening package starts at THB 131,888++, with taxes/service additions; this is not a day-visit price.
hours: Not yet verified for public areas, bars or restaurants. Hotel stays advertised from 20 December 2026.
bestTime: A late-afternoon riverside booking could combine daylight architecture with sunset drinks; confirm opening and seating before committing.
gettingThere: Bang Rak, Charoen Krung riverfront. Use the hotel's confirmed entrance pin when arranging a taxi; the reviewed sources do not establish visitor boat access or a public shuttle.
booking: Use Langham's official site for accommodation. Ask reservations whether non-residents can book the desired restaurant, enter heritage spaces, or join a heritage visit. Do not assume the package's private Heritage Journey is sold separately.
accessibility: Step-free routes through the restored building, accessible toilets and lift access were not verified. Obtain specific confirmation for your requirements.
practicalTips: Treat this as a flexible option until operations begin.
Check final bills and cancellation terms before paying for an opening offer.
Check dress requirements when reserving dining.
The older Time Out story predates the latest official plans; use current Langham details for booking decisions.
decemberNotes: Relevant only from 20 December 2026 onward under the announced schedule. Reconfirm shortly before travel: an opening reservation does not establish that every restaurant, heritage space or visitor experience will operate on the first day.
uncertainties: Actual completed opening and day-visitor arrangements remain unverified.
Public-area hours, menus, prices, dress codes and accessibility details are unknown.
No independently verified post-opening visitor experience was available at the planning date.
